claim_summary: Complete 16-vertex Clebsch strict-majority dynamical classification: 142 fixed states, 1165 primitive temporal two-cycles, 14 spatial classes and four-step sharp settling; all 140 nonuniform fixed states are balanced eigenvalue-one colorings with singleton basins.

integrity.methods: two standalone Python standard-library exhaustive verifiers, disjoint update implementations, precise state count 65536
integrity.originality_status: qualified by possible unindexed prior computation
integrity.proof_scope: exact finite dynamics and a spectral equilibrium lemma

scientific_limitations: This is a finite exact classification restricted to the degree-five Clebsch graph with synchronous neighbor-majority, not the complementary ten-regular graph.
The exact equilibrium population, isolation and basins use complete 65,536-state certificates; the balanced spectral characterization has a separate analytical proof.

The 2014-05-11 day-resolved source date refers to the verified first arXiv version of a relevant majority-dynamics paper; older 1980 and 1988 literature is acknowledged but its first day of public availability is not verified.
Absolute historical originality and independent mathematical validation have not been established.
title: Spectral rigidity and isolated equilibria in Clebsch majority dynamics
